text: ポケモンに　らんぼう　する　ひとは　ゆるさないわよ！

structure.jp: ポケモンに　らんぼう　する　ひとは
structure.en: people who are rough with Pokémon

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: ポケモンに　らんぼう　する　ひと
patterns.explanation: A short sentence placed right before a thing tells you which kind of thing it is. ポケモンに　らんぼう　する　ひと = 'people who are rough with Pokémon'.

patterns.name: 〜わ
patterns.explanation: わ at the end softens a statement and sounds womanly, and よ pushes the point at the listener. ゆるさないわよ = 'I won't forgive them, you hear'.
